limits: The project supplies tower location and separate20m navigation-light height. Published survey mesh supplies relative body/lantern dimensions, including20.45m vane tip; its20.75m raw span includes rough ground. No surveyed north axis or EXIF compass was supplied. Solar-wall bearing270degrees true is a photo/context reconstruction with22.5degree uncertainty, not a precise engineering azimuth. OSM keeper-house polygons are contextual controls only, not a lighthouse footprint or part of this model. Clean survey-derived octagonal base is explicitly reconstructed geometry. Detached houses, natural granite shore, exact present paint decay and interior operation are omitted; footprint replacement stays off.
